text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (I remember all of Grandma's magic—)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Because every single bit of it was 
thrilling, exciting, and the absolute 
best!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, look Grandma! The petunias and 
verbenas are all shiny and bright! 
Even though they were so withered 
yesterday!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I thought they were totally beyond 
saving! 
Grandma's magic really is amazing♪"

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, Sweepy, saying 'beyond saving'? 
Did you forget? The secret principle of 
magic."

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"You see, magic can't be cast just by 
chanting a spell. 
The most important thing is—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"To believe with all your heart that you 
can do it! 
I haven't forgotten, Grandma!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An encounter with a Racing Dress—it is 
something that can alter an Umamusume's 
destiny.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calling such encounters "Engagements," one 
designer crafts Racing Dresses inspired by 
wedding dresses.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, it's that time of the year 
again~! The BDC Muse Audition! 
We're calling for unpolished gems who can 
make my heart go spark-spark with 
excitement!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"By the way~ For this year's audition, 
we'll be testing your passion 
for how you want to showcase the racing 
outfit you win!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"To participate in the audition, you'll 
need a cooperative partner— 
a 'Muse Maid', so please keep that in 
mind~!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Muse Maids, please give your unpolished 
gems plenty of support 
so they can successfully become the Muse☆"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Ohohoho! It's finally here, the Muse 
Audition! 
I will claim that top-class designer's 
racing outfit for myself!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Beauty-san's racing outfit, the center of 
everyone's attention— 
I will be the one wearing it, without a 
doubt."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a Muse Audition, huh? Sounds 
interesting!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, it's about 'a spark of 
excitement', right? 
That's gotta mean—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, perfect! 
I, Sweepy the Magical Girl, will give them 
all the excitement they could ever want!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"And now, broadcasting live from this 
luxury cruise ship, 
our venue for this year's BDC Muse 
Audition!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"The ship is bustling with spectators, 
Muse candidates, 
and the Muse Maids here to support them!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Now, let's immediately interview the 
participants! 
First up—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Fresh off her glorious first GⅠ victory 
in the Victoria Mile, 
Verxina-san, and her Muse Maid, 
Vivlos-san!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I entered this audition to give physical 
form to my pride. 
I will prove that I possess the strength 
befitting a queen."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Haaai, I'm the Muse Maid, Vivlos~♡ 
I'll be giving my big sis my absolute best 
support!♡"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"—With you by my side, I cannot afford to 
look unseemly. 
I will definitely seize the title of Muse 
for myself!"

text_block_list.name: BDC Fan Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Kyaaa!! Lady Verxina! 
Good luck, Vivlos-chaaan!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Next up, fresh off her spirited, 
unforgettable run in the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen— 
King Halo-san!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Interviewing none other than this 
King—you certainly have an eye for talent. 
Very well, I grant you the privilege of 
asking me a question♪"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much, King Halo-san! 
Could you tell us what motivated you to 
participate this time?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, isn't it obvious? A racing outfit 
made by a first-rate designer 
is only fitting for a first-rate lady like 
myself, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: BDC Fan Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? But doesn't King's mother design 
racewear too? 
Why would she come to this audition—"

text_block_list.name: BDC Fan Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Idiot, don't you know? Just like Beauty, 
she's famous for 
only making outfits for Umamusume she 
personally acknowledges."

text_block_list.name: BDC Fan Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, but you never hear about King 
getting one made, right? 
So she's probably trying to get Beauty's 
outfit to show her mother..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"And now, allow me to introduce my 
first-rate Muse Maid♪ 
...Wait, huh? Where did she wander off to? 
Hey!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Geez... King, you're the main star here, 
so do I really have to? 
Just let me relax until the real thing 
starts~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, Sei-chan is only playing along 
because 
you wouldn't stop crying and begging~."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wait! Nobody was crying! 
You get to be THIS King's Muse Maid, you 
know?! You should be weeping tears of 
joy!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"What an incredible turn of events—could 
King Halo-san's Muse Maid 
actually be Seiun Sky-san?!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Rivals of the 'Golden Generation' who 
clashed in countless Classic battles, 
now joining forces in a dream team! You 
can't take your eyes off this!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, naturally, isn't it? 
After all, this King and Sky-san are—"
"Geeeez, ENOUGH ALREADY!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa, what's that? 
It seems some trouble has broken out over 
there!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"How many times do I have to say it?! 
I'm not bringing along any Muse Maid!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I can manage just fine on my own! 
I don't need any helpers!"

text_block_list.name: BDC Staff
text_block_list.text:
"However, participating with a partner is 
the general rule... 
Wouldn't competing all by yourself put you 
at a huge disadvantage?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph! I can use magic, you know! 
Something like that isn't a disadvantage 
at all!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I want to show my magic to 
Grandma! 
I came here to show her that I've gotten 
closer to becoming a true witch!"

text_block_list.name: BDC Staff
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. If you accept the 
disadvantage, 
we will process your registration."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Unbelievable! Sweep Tosho-san has 
declared she will enter alone!! 
With tension in the air, the Muse Audition 
is finally about to begin!!"
